anoa_11_shades_killed_10.m: Good work, my friend. You have saved Dhayavar.

anoa_11_shades_killed_20.m: You shall have your reward. But first you shall know my secret: I was the twelfth shade.

anoa_11_shades_killed_30.m: Worry not, fear not - I shall not harm you. When I said that in the confusion of the War, us shades hid, that's not strictly true. An Elytharan mage caught up with me, who was about to be the last to hide. She could have killed us, but I think her energy was nearly spent.

anoa_11_shades_killed_40.m: Instead she told me: "Until now, you have sustained fantasies in which you are the adventurers in magic, the pioneers in a new form of magic. Comforting daydreams in which you are always right. But no more. The fantasy is over. I have taken it away. For this is my judgement upon you: that you shall know, from this moment on, exactly how craven and selfish and monstrous you are."

anoa_11_shades_killed_50.m: Her spell stripped away my justifications. It made me realize what a monster I was.

anoa_11_shades_killed_60.m: Then she said - when your erstwhile colleagues, who hide now, are neutralized, you shall find peace. So $playername, thank you for liberating me.

anoa_after_ring.m: Wear it if you want to overcome the resistance of the Kha'zaan shades. It should let you get past their safeguards.

anoa_after_ring_10.m: So the Holy One gave you a ring.

anoa_after_ring_after_orders.m: I told you already, wear the ring that the Holy One give you if you want to overcome the resistance of the Kha'zaan shades.
r: Oh, yeah. I will try that now.

anoa_clarity_10.m: You foolish child. Buried here are the shades of the Kha'zaan. You must destroy them.

anoa_dropped_ring_10.m: Child...you cast aside the Holy One's blessing? Retrieve the ring from where you left it. Only then can I complete what must be done.

r: I'm getting thrown out of Undertell.

anoa_forgot_ring_10.m: The Holy One gave you a relic did it not? Bring it to me.

anoa_intro_10.m: You foolish child! Long were buried here the evil souls of the Kha'zaan. No one was to come here near these shades. Now your presence shall free them to wreak havoc on Dhayavar.

anoa_one_plus_shades_freed_12.m: Wear the ring that the Holy One give you if you want to talk to me.
r: Oh, you now too? Let me put it on now.

anoa_one_plus_shades_freed_15.m: What have you done? Don't you realize the evil you have unleashed. Thanks to an Elytharan mage, my soul which was to be liberated, is now getting reinfected.

anoa_one_plus_shades_freed_20.m: What you don't realize is that I was the twelfth shade.

anoa_one_plus_shades_freed_30.m: When we were about to go into hiding, an Elytharan mage caught up with me. She stripped away my fantasies of being a pioneer in a new type of magic: Kazaul's magic, and laid bare what I had become - a monster.

anoa_ring_check_10.m: Before I depart, child...the blessing must be passed on. Give me the ring granted by the Holy One.

anoa_ring_upgrade_10.m: As you have truly vanquished the Kha'zaan and resisted their whispers, Elythara grants her favor. Through this ring, her blessing now flows anew.

anoa_second_return_10.m: You're back again without the job being completed?
r: No luck. I'm still getting thrown out of the caverns.

anoa_shades_freed_1.m: Now, no thanks to you, my soul has become reinfected, and we shall lay Dhayavar to waste, starting with you.
r: I was hoping that it wouldn't come to this.

anoa_story_20a.m: Child, if you knew the history of the world of Dhayavar, you would know how this place came to be. How the Lethgar were subjugated to Kazaul's will. How a few of the Lethgar became interested in the Dark Sorcery of Kazaul.

anoa_story_20b.m: The past is never dead. It is not even past.

anoa_story_20c.m: As you wish. So those Lethgar who were interested in the Dark Sorcery became none other than the Kha'zaan. Word spread that the Kha'zaan, through their devotion, were among the strongest followers of Kazaul.
r: The Kha'zaan were defeated in the War of Dawn, weren't they?

anoa_story_20d.m: Devotion. Remember that word. It holds more power than you think.

anoa_story_20e.m: Through devotion, even if the Kha'zaan lost their corporeal forms, they became incorporeal shades. And survived.

anoa_story_20f.m: During the confusion of the War, this section was overlooked. As the Elytharan mages cleansed Dhayavar, the war reached Undertell and was fought in these passages. Spells and counterspells everywhere. In this confusion, the shades hid here, weakened but alive. And here they remain.
r: Let them be. I will just search for my brother Andor and get out. Tell me what to avoid.

anoa_story_20g.m: If only it were that simple. These shades gain strength from the life force of the living. As no one has come here, and you are the first, they shall awaken. The longer you stay, the stronger they will grow. Soon enough they will escape these passages and haunt Dhayavar once more.
r: What do I need to do?

anoa_story_20h.m: You must destroy each shade you encounter in this cavern. There were twelve who hid here. You should find eleven of them still around.

anoa_story_20i.m: There is not much time to tell you more. The shades grow stronger. Go hunt them! May Elythara bless you.

r: It is no use. They are just making me disoriented. Maybe I should give up?

anoa_third_return_20.m: Not if you want to save your brother, your family and Dhayavar.

anoa_third_return_40.m: In the town of Sullengard, there is a statue of Elythara. Pray to her for aid.
r: That is the statue of Elythara? So close to Nor City?

anoa_third_return_50.m: Sullengard is a riddle bound in contradiction. Though it stands as the southernmost town sworn to the light of Elythara, it does not bend the knee to Feygard. Its people hold Feygard in quiet contempt, for its levies, its corruptions, its heavy rule, and the favoring of blood over merit. They veil these sentiments behind courteous silence, and so to outsiders they seem neutral. Even the statue bears no name. It is spoken of only as the Holy One.
r: And me praying will not kick a hornet's nest?

anoa_third_return_60.m: No one will notice. Except maybe a few kids.

anoa_welcome.m: Why did you have to come here?
r: I need clarity. What am I supposed to be doing?

anoa_who_are_you_10.m: Child, I will tell you later. Not enough time to tell you. Go hunt!

anona_fight.m: Now, no thanks to you, my soul has become reinfected, and we shall lay Dhayavar to waste, starting with you.
r: Today, you will be removed from this world.

devotion.20: Anoa told me that my presence in this cavern of Undertell had reawakened 11 shades of the Kha'zaan, who were dormant. I needed to eliminate them before they destroyed Dhayavar. It was their devotion to Kazaul which had preserved their existence till now.
devotion.30: I approached a Kha'zaan shade. But it was powerful enough to throw me out of the caverns and even out of Undertell. I needed to talk to Anoa.
devotion.40: Anoa told me to try again.
devotion.50: I again approached a shade. Again, I was thrown. Hope Anoa had a better alternative.
devotion.60: Anoa again told me to try harder.
devotion.70: Once more I was thrown out of the caverns the moment I approached a shade. This time, Anoa better help me in a smart way.
devotion.80: Anoa told me to pray to the statue of the Holy One in Sullengard square.
devotion.90: I prayed to the Holy One. I saw a ring at the foot of the statue.
devotion.100: I picked up the ring. I needed to get back to Anoa to learn how it works.
devotion.110: Anoa told me to wear it and approach the Kha'zaan shade.
devotion.120: A shade pleaded for mercy, promising a reward someday. I decided to let it go.
devotion.150: The shade claimed it was no monster at all and begged for freedom. I chose to release it.
devotion.180: The shade insisted it did not deserve destruction. I chose to free it.
devotion.210: A shade spoke of oppression and suffering rather than evil. I released it from its binding.
devotion.240: One shade swore it meant no harm and only wanted to be free. I granted its request.
devotion.270: A shade appealed to my compassion, asking for release instead of destruction. I let it go.
devotion.300: The shade asked for freedom. I allowed it to depart.
devotion.330: A shade promised gratitude if spared. I chose mercy and let it slip away.
devotion.360: The shade asked to be released. I loosened its hold on this place.
devotion.390: One of the shades spoke with unexpected clarity, begging for freedom. I gave it what it asked for.
devotion.420: A shade insisted it only wanted release, not destruction. I freed it from its lingering prison.
devotion.450: I had eliminated all the Kha'zaan shades and Anoa thanked me. As the 12th shade, one in redemption, eliminating the rest had freed him.
devotion.470: Anoa informed me that he could have been redeemed, but because I freed at least one of the Kha'zaan shades, this was not to happen. Thus he became a monstrous shade. He and all of the freed shades swarmed and attacked me.
devotion.480: I killed all the shades including Anoa. I did not get any reward.
